Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one concept illustration for the 心域智链 project defense PowerPoint.
Revise the attached reference's visual storytelling to clearly show AI-assisted record summarization, rather than a generic student/teacher conversation. Preserve its warm human editorial style, clean near-black outlines, purple #604372/#78558F, apricot #E8B185 and sage #8BA696 accents, transparent background. This is not a website design.
Composition: one wide triptych scene on a 1800 x 900 transparent canvas, all three scenes linked organically on the same baseline, no panel borders. Left third: a university student at laptop alongside a small stack of dated assessment record sheets, one sheet has a missing field, neutral data marks only. Middle third: an abstract purple document-processing workstation (computer, ordered source documents and a draft sheet emerging) signifies an AI text assistant. Show small matching citation tabs on input and output sheets and a magnifying-glass source check, visually connecting records and approved documents to a draft. Right third: a teacher at desk cross-checking the draft against original records, holding a pen and making a correction. Make the central processing visibly distinct and prominent, and the teacher visibly responsible for final review.
No humanoid robot, no medical diagnosis or treatment, no hospital, no risk meter, no brain scan, no hearts, no therapy couch, no exaggerated futuristic glowing networks. No invented numeric results. No text, no letters including AI, no digits, no logos, no watermark. PPT will overlay editable labels separately. Complete silhouettes and all limbs, normal hands, crisp edges, comfortable negative space, no cropped desk. Flat vector-like illustration output PNG. This is a proposed workflow scene, not proof of an implemented model or real event. Current date anchor 2026-10-28, no visible dates.
